integrity: A complete restricted-growth recursion enumerates one representative of every alphabet-permutation orbit through length 181. Richness and abelian-cube-freeness are checked incrementally by exact defining criteria, and the four final words receive independent direct factor-level checks.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only the equality cases at the ternary rich abelian-cube-free maximum length 180. It does not address the binary abelian-fourth-power-free maximum or infinite avoidance.
title: Complete extremizer classification at the ternary rich abelian-cube boundary
